2026-08-30 MID: **One swap -- BCH dropped, NEAR added (2/5 slot-change budget used this new week Sun 08-30 - Sat 09-05, reset from last week's 4/5).** universe.py rerun (116 candidates, 12 stable/wrapped excluded, top 60 enriched). Red-flag screen (window 2026-08-29 to 2026-08-30, web search: hack/exploit, SEC/CFTC enforcement, team-exit/founder-scandal sweeps): **no new hack/regulatory/team-exit events found tied to any of the 30 watchlist tickers or the NEAR candidate.** Checked and ruled non-actionable/already logged: Coldcard hardware-wallet hack aftermath (~$130M revised total, infra/wallet-provider layer), SEC FRAU enforcement unit (08-05) and Regulation Crypto Assets proposal (08-18, general rulemaking, not ticker-specific), Story Protocol co-founder 'soft rug pull' exit (08-16, not a watchlist ticker), Ostium $18M oracle-manipulation exploit (07-15, Arbitrum perp-DEX, not a watchlist ticker -- an initial NEAR-adjacent search snippet conflated this with NEAR Protocol; verified via follow-up search it is unrelated to NEAR, no genuine NEAR security incident found). BCH itself: no red flag, drop is a pure quality/catalyst call (see below). No-chase check: NEAR at -4.0% 7d, well clear of the >50% 7d exclude. **Swap reasoning:** NEAR (rank 39, mcap $2.45B, vol/mcap 0.067, sentiment 100.0, +96.1% 200d, -4.0% 7d) was flagged as a standout runner-up on 2026-08-25/08-28/08-29 MID but budget-blocked each time; with the budget now reset, actioned this run. Filled by dropping **BCH** (score 5, the lowest-catalyst rotating holding -- original thesis literally reads "low-beta placeholder", -51.1% 200d, thin vol/mcap 0.017, no genuine catalyst found in this run's news sweep beyond a payments-card pilot at Cash 3.0 Conference 08-01/02 -- not a fresh catalyst). AI sector moves 3/4 -> 4/4 (at cap, not exceeding); Payments moves 3/4 -> 2/4. **INJ** (rank 101, mcap $529M, vol/mcap 0.102, sentiment 80.0, 7d +4.5%, clean red-flag screen) remains flagged but **not actioned** -- sector fit still genuinely ambiguous (DEX 4/4 capped; DeFi Lending 3/4 technically open but INJ is a general-purpose L1 for on-chain finance, not a lending protocol like AAVE/ENA/MORPHO -- forcing the classification to open a slot would be the kind of rubric-stretching Section 9 warns against). Held/armed/locked: XLM, MORPHO held (2/5 positions, locked from rotation-out); no coin currently armed (JUP's PM 08-29 arming lapsed on non-confirmation at AM 08-30, no arming this checkpoint per CHECKPOINT_LOG). ASTER and ICP (added 2026-08-16) cleared the 2-week minimum today (2026-08-30) -- both reviewed as drop candidates and kept: ASTER has genuine trading history this paper phase (confirmed & entered 08-26, cut on non-confirmation) despite a middling 40% CoinGecko community-sentiment score (a noisy poll metric, distinct from the Grok/X parameter-1 read used at checkpoints), and ICP screens cleanly (96.15% sentiment, +19.1% 30d, flat 7d) -- neither is the weakest slot on the board. POL (added 08-23) and PYTH (added 08-24) remain inside their own 2-week minimums (unlock 09-06 and 09-07 respectively) -- locked from drop regardless. Sector caps after swap: DEX 4/4, Major L1 4/4 (permanent), DeFi Lending 3/4, Meme 3/4, AI 4/4, Payments 2/4, L2 2/4, Oracle 2/4, Enterprise 1/4, Liquid Staking 1/4, RWA 1/4, DePIN/Storage 0/4. state/PARAMETERS.json to be refreshed for the updated 30 immediately after this note so the PM checkpoint starts warm.
